title: loadState
description: Load the cookies and `localStorage` saved by `saveState`, or by Playwright's `storageState`, into the open site. Open the site with `goTo` first.

anyOf.title: State file path
anyOf.description: Path of the state file, ending in `.json`. A relative path resolves against `outputDir`.

path.title: State file path
path.description: Path of the state file, ending in `.json`. A relative path resolves against `directory`, or against `outputDir` when `directory` is omitted.

directory.title: Directory path
directory.description: Directory to load the state file from. A relative directory resolves against the spec file. Omit it to load from `outputDir`.
